scope: Roots launched since 2026-10-22 whose user messages explicitly reference the S10 quota-repair or B2 handoff paths; all recursive Codex descendants in 260-file metadata index. Two separately located Claude review sessions inspected. Not an all-time inventory.
method: Per-response token_usage_record, unique response_id, attributed by thread_id (session_id is shared by Codex children). Compaction markers in recorded prefixes. Truncation markers are diagnostic candidates.
limitations: Retrospective, mixed task/instruction versions; no causal treatment comparison
Running sessions observed only through cutoff
Encrypted inter-agent message contents cannot be semantically audited
Codex input-token sums include cached input and are not billed cost
Claude native processes are outside Codex lineage totals
No exhaustive audit of every accepted code result or semantic handoff obligation

findings.finding: Zeroed post-compaction token_count accepted as valid normal input=0
Delivered pressure did not lead to a fresh capacity judgment before new implementation work
S10 successor uses explicit checks and old binary, not automatic control enrollment
Large startup reads and self-post listener wakeups create avoidable context overhead
findings.evidence: See report; truncation marker counts are a diagnostic, not exact lost-token measurement
